title: Philips DDL240X-1HBG-L-MB WiFi Fingerprint Smart Lock with Lever Handle (Matte Black)

comparisons.notes: Exact title, Matte Black, model DDL240-1HBG-L-MB, UPC 850071183719; in stock (product data available=true).

writeup: The Philips DDL240X-1HBG-L-MB WiFi smart lock set in matte black, with lever handles and a WiFi gateway, is $69.99 new on Woot. It stores up to 50 fingerprints and works with Alexa and Google Assistant for voice and remote control. Fixwell Home lists the same set at $233.99, and Woot showed only 1 left with a limit of 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Verified exact match by UPC 850071183719 and model DDL240(X)-1HBG-L-MB.
